name: assets_handover
description: GH #3889 / REQ-753 (assets C11), docs/assets/asset-workflow-documents.md. The header of a hand over of assets to another org unit or location (cause handover, prefix AHO). It is written only by module assets (managed type), same shape rules as assets_commission: document_id is the id of the versioned document that carries state and number; org_unit_id is the issuing (handing) org unit, the scope column. Master ids are record ids of other modules (no foreign key; checked at issue). After issue nothing of the header changes. No price or value is stored.
